name: Tether Georgian Lari Stablecoin
oneLiner: GEL₮ is Tether's pre-launch Georgian Lari stablecoin, announced May 2026 with the Government of Georgia under the NBG's 100%-reserve framework.
collateral: Planned 1:1 Georgian Lari-denominated reserves under National Bank of Georgia Order No. 52/04 (100% reserve backing, full redemption rights); reserve composition, custodian, and attestation not yet disclosed
pegMechanism: Pre-launch fiat-referenced stablecoin digitally representing the Georgian Lari; designed for 1:1 GEL backing with full redemption rights under NBG oversight, though chains, contracts, reserve disclosures, and launch timing remain unannounced
launchPhaseDetail: Announced May 25 2026 as a joint Tether / Government of Georgia initiative to place the Georgian Lari on digital-asset rails; not a CBDC (distinct from the NBG's separate digital-lari pilot). Grounded in NBG Order No. 52/04 (March 6 2026), which lets licensed VASPs issue Lari-pegged stablecoins under 100% reserve backing, prior NBG consent, full redemption rights, and GEL 500,000 minimum issuer capital; framework built for compatibility with the US GENIUS Act. Endorsed by PM Irakli Kobakhidze and NBG President Natia Turnava. Tether signed an MOU with Georgia in June 2023 and has invested in CityPay.io (active at 2,000+ Georgian merchant locations); GEL₮ is stated to be issued on multiple blockchains. Chains, contract addresses, reserve disclosures, banking partners, and launch timing to be announced at a later stage.
